title: Sparkly diamond
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='diamondGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7DE8FF'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#30B8E8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#1467A8'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='tableGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#C8F6FF'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#7DE8FF'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- top table of the diamond -->
  <polygon points='50,18 68,36 50,44 32,36' fill='url(#tableGrad)'/>
  <!-- crown facets -->
  <polygon points='32,36 50,44 50,64 24,44' fill='#5FD6F5'/>
  <polygon points='68,36 50,44 50,64 76,44' fill='#2C9FD6'/>
  <!-- pavilion (bottom point) -->
  <polygon points='24,44 50,64 50,84' fill='url(#diamondGrad)'/>
  <polygon points='76,44 50,64 50,84' fill='#1E7FBF'/>
  <!-- sparkles around the diamond -->
  <g fill='#FFE873'>
    <polygon points='18,20 20,26 26,28 20,30 18,36 16,30 10,28 16,26'/>
    <polygon points='82,16 84,22 90,24 84,26 82,32 80,26 74,24 80,22'/>
    <polygon points='86,70 88,75 93,77 88,79 86,84 84,79 79,77 84,75'/>
    <polygon points='14,66 16,71 21,73 16,75 14,80 12,75 7,73 12,71'/>
    <polygon points='50,90 51,94 55,95 51,96 50,100 49,96 45,95 49,94'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#FFFFFF'>
    <circle cx='50' cy='12' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='94' cy='50' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='6' cy='44' r='2'/>
  </g>
</svg>
